ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 44

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

7. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 16

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 105

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

15. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 25
   D. 6

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 19

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 22

18. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

19. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

20. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 50
   C. 10
   D. 11

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 30
   C. 40
   D. 75

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 22
   C. 32
   D. 16

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 17
   D. 23
